title: Locally Robust Inference with Outcomes Predicted by Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21756v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many parameters of interest in economics depend on outcomes generated by machine learning (ML).These generated outcomes are subsequently used in standard econometric estimation and typically treated as observed, a practice that threatens the validity of downstream inference. Empirically relevant cases include dynamic treatment effects under sequential exogeneity, long-term effects with surrogates, the partially linear model with an ML-predicted outcome, productivity persistence with an unrestricted production function and constructed instruments, and outcomes residualized of confounding variation. This paper develops a three-step locally robust GMM framework for valid inference when the dependent variable is generated by ML. We construct a debiased moment condition that augments the identifying moment with first- and second-step influence functions, making inference on the parameter of interest locally insensitive to regularization and m

translated_title: 机器学习预测结果下的局部稳健推断
translated_abstract: 经济学中的许多关注参数依赖于由机器学习（ML）生成的结果。这些生成的结果随后被用于标准的计量经济学估计中，并且通常被当作实际观测数据来处理，这种做法会威胁下游推断的有效性。具有实证意义的情形包括：序贯外生性下的动态处理效应、借助替代指标的长期效应、因变量由机器学习预测的部分线性模型、带有无限制生产函数和构造工具变量的生产率持续性，以及剔除了混杂变异的结果。本文针对因变量由机器学习生成的情形，开发了一个三步局部稳健GMM框架以实现有效推断。我们构建了一个去偏矩条件，该条件在识别矩的基础上加入了第一阶段和第二阶段的影响函数，使得对关注参数的推断对正则化和模型（截断处摘要不完整）
tldr: 本文提出一个三步局部稳健GMM框架，通过构建包含前两步影响函数的去偏矩条件，使得当因变量由机器学习生成时，对经济参数的推断对正则化和模型选择局部不敏感，从而保证下游推断的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a three-step locally robust GMM framework with a debiased moment condition that augments the identifying moment with first- and second-step influence functions, enabling valid inference on economic parameters when the dependent variable is generated by machine learning.
